theories.claim: Browser QA operation serializer drops focused shard/suite causing map-owned shard contract violation
theories.basis: internal/web/operation_handlers.go:735-751 enforces QA operations accept only options.shard or options.suite with strict kind checks (qa-start/resume only for shard, start/dry-run only for suite, mutual exclusion). The modular static/js/operations.js:5-17 and legacy fallback static/app.js:630-647 must preserve those fields under confirmation. operations_contract_test.go:68-86 asserts update of this contract.
theories.verification_surface: Inspection of operation_handlers.go mapOperationRequest QA validation block, static/js/operations.js options and command, static/app.js specification fallback, operations_contract_test.go TestBrowserQAOperationContractAllowsOnlyMapOwnedShard and templates_test.go modular serializer check
theories.confirmation_condition: Static client serialization omits shard/suite or maps them to wrong key (e.g., task) so a valid QA start/resume with shard yields invalid_request/unsupported kind or server drops shard
theories.refutation_condition: Both operation clients map selectedShard to result.shard and suite to result.suite and mapOperationSpec round-trips shard via options.shard for qa-start/qa-resume, and tests enforce it
theories.inconclusive_condition: Client embedding or dynamic form dataset values (data-shard, data-suite) not visible in assigned static paths
theories.safe_evidence_strategy: Read static/js/operations.js:5-18, static/app.js:630-647 specification fallback, operation_handlers.go:735-760 and 755-787 mapping, and operations_contract_test.go:68-86 without executing browser

theories.claim: QA issues collection query parameters are rejected before reaching handler due to global dispatch allowsQuery allowlist
theories.basis: internal/web/handlers.go:422 defines allowsQuery only for api_validations, api_runs, api_run_events, runs, api_timeline. internal/web/routes.go:373 maps /api/v1/projects/{project}/sprints/{sprint}/qa/issues to api_sprint_qa_issues and internal/web/qa_handlers.go:51-71 expects to read ?limit and ?cursor via r.URL.Query(). The dispatch block handlers.go:422-425 returns 400 invalid_request when RawQuery != "" for any route not in allowsQuery, so a valid call like GET /api/v1/projects/alpha/sprints/30-web/qa/issues?limit=10&cursor=... will be rejected before QAIssues query. No other middleware exempts QA routes.
theories.verification_surface: Static inspection of handlers.go dispatch, routes.go matchRoute for api_sprint_qa_issues/api_sprint_qa_issue, qa_handlers.go handleSprintQAIssues query handling; compare with routes_test.go TestAPIValidationAndIdentifierBoundaries which verifies invalid_request for unknown queries but does not cover QA issue pagination
theories.confirmation_condition: Code shows api_sprint_qa_issues not in allowsQuery set while its handler reads URL query limit/cursor, and a read-only request with ?limit or ?cursor to that path is classified as known API route and blocked at dispatch
theories.refutation_condition: Code shows api_sprint_qa_issues is included in allowsQuery or QA issues endpoint is intentionally non-paginated / query params are handled via different path or dispatch exempts QA routes elsewhere
theories.inconclusive_condition: Cannot locate dispatch or route definitions or handler pagination intent within assigned paths without expanded context
theories.safe_evidence_strategy: Read handlers.go:422-436 dispatch and allowed query set, read routes.go:373-382 QA route mapping, read qa_handlers.go:51-71 query parsing, search handlers.go for additional allowsQuery exemptions without executing handlers

theories.claim: QA handlers leak internal causes or panic when QA capability is absent
theories.basis: internal/web/routes.go:71-75 obtains QA via opts.Operations.(QAQueries) fallback to opts.Queries.(QAQueries) leaving h.qa nil when neither implements. All QA handlers in qa_handlers.go guard with if h.qa == nil and QAEvidenceQueries type assertions, delegating to handleQueryError with apiRoute=true. handleQueryError in handlers.go:1056-1080 maps QAUseCaseError to stable public codes with category/operation/guidance and maps generic errors to not_found/unavailable without leaking secret strings, as verified by routes_test.go:185-203.
theories.verification_surface: Code inspection of routes.go NewHandler QA wiring, qa_handlers.go nil and capability checks, handlers.go handleQueryError and writeQAError detail construction; contrast with TestQAQueryErrorsUseStablePublicCodes and TestAPIErrorProjectionDoesNotLeakInternalCause
theories.confirmation_condition: Any QA handler dereferences nil h.qa, returns Go error text/persistence paths, or emits stack/secret in error envelope for non-QA errors
theories.refutation_condition: All QA entry points return handleQueryError with true API flag and safe public code/message, with writeQAError detail limited to category/operation/guidance/component/correlation_id and without internal text
theories.inconclusive_condition: QA wiring or error projection spans context beyond assigned files without approval
theories.safe_evidence_strategy: Read routes.go:70-76, all functions in qa_handlers.go:10-201 for h.qa nil checks and type assertions, read handlers.go:1056-1130 error mapping and templateText escaping without invoking network
